simple.summary: עָפַל (ʻâphal) means to swell ; figuratively, be elated First listed occurrence: Hab 2 4.

definitions.full: H6075. aphal I. עָפַל verb swell (?; so Thes; inferred from derivatives; Arabic is a tumour in the vulva or anus, apparently denominative (compare II. עֹפֶל ) see Assyrian uplu , probably tumour (Dl HWB 7 ublu , but see Jen ThLz 1895, 250 )); — Pu`al Perfect 3feminine singular עֻמְּלָה Hab 2:4 according to ᵑ0 (subject נַפְשׁוֺ , compare GASm); but substantive needed, Brd SK 1889, 121 הַנֶּעֱלָף , We Now הָעַוָּל , compare Gu Kau. — Hiph`il see II. עפל . below II. [ עָפַל ] verb perhaps be heedless (Arabic be heedless, neglectful, inadvertent) ; — Hiph`il shew heedlessness, Imperfect 3masculine plural לַעֲלוֺת וַיַּעְמִּלוּ Num 14:44 (JE) they shewed heedlessness in going up (went up heedlessly), so de Dieu, cited (and allowed) by Di Buhl Lex ; > Thes and others shewed presumption (I. עפל , this sense dubious).
